sentence: This project builds teaching modules and online training in AI and genomics for faculty at teaching-intensive institutions.
This project works to turn laboratory discoveries into better cancer therapies for patients.
This project runs a laboratory and lecture course on using Xenopus, the African clawed frog, to study development and disease.
This project tries to find out how gut microbes in people break down xenobiotics, using mass spectrometry.
This project builds tools that measure DNA methylation in single cells.
This project studies how regulatory T cells help breast cancer avoid attack by the immune system.
This project studies how skin stem cells remember inflammation and stress, and how those memories affect wounds and cancer.
This project supports HIV research by offering laboratory tests and model systems to study how viruses interact with host cells.
This project studies a pathway that controls blood levels of signaling molecules linked to obesity and type 2 diabetes.
This project studies how sleep relates to depression in a mouse model of autism.
This project uses computer simulations and artificial intelligence to find out how CRISPR gene editors work at the molecular level.
This project tests whether drugs can prevent or treat a heart rhythm condition called atrial fibrillation in cancer patients.
This project studies a mutated protein that changes other proteins and may cause abnormal heart rhythms and heart failure.
This project provides organoids, human cell lines and gene-edited mice to help researchers study digestive disorders.
This project studies how large oncosomes from cancer transfer mitochondria and metabolites to fibroblasts.
This project studies how glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists help patients with stage 2 type 1 diabetes who are treated with teplizumab.
This project studies how neighborhood features and where people spend time affect cognitive aging and dementia.
This project builds a machine learning tool that uses noninvasive physiological signals to monitor dyspnea in real time.
This project prints wearable magnetic sensors to record the heart's magnetic fields and uses machine learning to classify heart rhythms.
This project studies how to engineer immune cells and stem cells so transplants and cell therapies work better against cancer.
